sections.lead: Start with one low-conflict statement: name your current preference or minimum position without trying to resolve the whole disagreement.

points: Saying ‘anything is fine’ despite a preference: You already lean toward an option but keep it hidden, leaving others unable to account for your choice.

Easy tasks replace the real issue: Organizing, scrolling, or low-effort work takes over while the important decision remains untouched.
